name: Facebook Pages
shortInfo: Insights from facebook pages like visitor count or share count
brief: This Connector enables streaming relevant Facebook Pages performance data into a user determined data warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
about:
Build an online business profile and get discovered by fans and customers with a Facebook Page. With a Facebook Page, you can manage all aspects of your business to keep customers updated, publish and promote content, connect people with your products and deliver seamless customer service experiences.  
  
Learn more about [Facebook Pages API documentation.](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/pages)
availableData:
[Insights](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/facebook-pages/pipelines/insights.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance metrics for your Facebook Pages and Page posts.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/facebook-pages/index.html) here.
